name: ui-code-review
description: UI code review for Git Pull Requests and TFVC changesets: reviews changed UI files against AXIS (R-xx), localization (I18N-xx), UI security (SEC-xx), images and assets (PERF-xx) and accessibility (A11Y-xx) rules, checks that the change does what its linked Bug / User Story asks (FIX-xx), and posts the findings as comments.
